title: Enterprise Account Executive - industrial or technology-driven sectors
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.
Job Category
Sales
Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
The Enterprise Account Executive is part of Salesforce’s Enterprise Sales organization, supporting customers in Manufacturing, Automotive, Utilities, Travel& Transportation or Technology.
You will lead a focused portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts,. Working with senior customer executives and a cross-functional Salesforce account team, you will develop and execute account strategies that advance customers’ business priorities, accelerate digital transformation, and support their evolution toward an Agentic Enterprise—where people and trusted AI agents work together to drive measurable outcomes.
As both a strategic commercial leader and a technically fluent seller, you will connect business priorities with Salesforce’s platform, data, AI, integration, and cloud capabilities. You will be expected to lead credible conversations with business and technology executives, translate complex requirements into compelling solution strategies, and mobilize the right technical expertise throughout the sales cycle.
This role combines executive relationship leadership, consultative and technical selling, complex commercial execution, and cross-functional account orchestration.
What You’ll Do
Lead the account strategy: Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-year account plans aligned with customers’ strategic priorities, technology roadmaps, and Salesforce’s growth objectives.
Build executive relationships: Establish trusted-advisor relationships with C-level and senior business and technology leaders, bringing relevant industry insights, technical perspectives, and compelling points of view.
Drive business transformation: Translate customers’ business challenges and technology constraints into high-value platform, data, AI, and cloud strategies supported by clear business cases and measurable outcomes.
Lead business and technical discovery: Uncover customer objectives, business processes, architecture, data environment, integration requirements, security considerations, and transformation priorities. Identify gaps, dependencies, and potential barriers early in the sales cycle.
Shape the solution strategy and narrative: Partner with Solution Engineering, architects, and specialist teams to connect Salesforce capabilities to customer requirements and articulate how the proposed solution will deliver business and technical value.
Communicate across business and technology audiences: Make complex technology concepts accessible to business executives while clearly communicating business priorities, value drivers, and commercial implications to technical stakeholders.
Develop an Agentic Enterprise point of view: Help customers understand how trusted AI agents, unified data, automation, and human expertise can work together to transform customer and employee experiences.
Orchestrate the account team: Align Specialist Account Executives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, Professional Services, partners, and global system integrators around a unified customer and solution strategy.
Navigate complex sales cycles: Lead multi-stakeholder, multi-product enterprise opportunities from qualification and technical discovery through validation, negotiation, and close.
Required Qualifications
Demonstrated success in complex or enterprise software or SaaS sales, management consulting, technology consulting, or large-scale digital transformation.
Relevant experience in Manufacturing, Automotive, Utilities, Travel& Transportation or Technology and an understanding of its business models, operating challenges, technology landscape, and regulatory environment.
A track record of developing strategic enterprise accounts and meeting or exceeding significant revenue targets.
Experience leading complex, multi-year sales cycles involving multiple business units, senior executives, procurement teams, enterprise architects, security teams, and other technical stakeholders.
Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate effectively with C-level executives, operational leaders, and technical audiences.
Ability to develop credible perspectives on how data, AI, automation, and cloud platforms can enable business transformation.
Experience partnering with Solution Engineers, architects, product specialists, services teams, and implementation partners during technical evaluations.
Strong commercial judgment, negotiation skills, forecasting discipline, curiosity, and resilience.
Professional fluency in German and English, written and spoken, for customer and internal collaboration.
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Posting Statement
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
